title: The Day of the Jackal
author: Frederick Forsyth
summary: In 1963 a secret group of French extremists hires a British professional killer to assassinate President de Gaulle. French police race to identify him before he reaches Paris.
readIf: you like procedural suspense where meticulous planning drives the tension, even though you know history.
skipIf: you want deep character studies, because this is told mostly through process.

pairings.reason: A higher-octane chase with a trained operative running across Europe.
Cold War espionage that is just as cool and exact, but far more morally weary.
A slower, subtler spy novel built on patience and deduction.
